title: CAD Parameter Catalog — hyperCAD-S ~275 Schemas
description: Generate complete parameter schemas, skills, AC Python scripts, and validation hooks for all ~275 hyperCAD-S CAD input parameters. Covers sketch constraints (~80 params), solid modeling (extrude/revolve/fillet ~50), surface operations (~40), analysis tools (~30), electrode design (~25), import/export settings (~20), measure/bounding (~30). Each parameter gets a Zod schema, skill template, AC setter script, and safety hook rule.

reference: hyperCAD-S training manuals (sketch, solid, surface, analysis, electrode sections)

forge_triple.hook: cadParameterRangeValidator — BUILT — blocks out-of-range CAD params
forge_triple.action: generate_cad_catalog — BUILT — generates CAD domain artifacts from schemas
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-cad-params — BUILT — CAD parameter reference and recommendations

sessions.intent: Generate schemas for surface operation parameters (~40), analysis tool parameters (~30), and electrode design parameters (~25). Surface schemas include continuity (G0/G1/G2) validation. Electrode schemas include spark gap and overcut validation hooks.
